text_block_list.text:
A make-or-break summer had arrived ahead 
of the Kikuka Sho. The bus departed for 
the training camp, heading toward an 
auspicious direction.

Matikanefukukitaru rejoices over her good 
luck. However, the bus passes right by the 
lucky direction and heads straight toward 
misfortune.

Fearing that countless trials and 
tribulations awaited her at the training 
camp, Matikanefukukitaru fell into 
despair.
